A great place to be

We’re committed to being a great place to be. A place with a winning culture that stems from our openness, inclusiveness, accountability, and of course our commitment to each other.

Be part of a cutting-edge industry

As a market leader with a diverse portfolio, we’re driven by technologies and our incredibly bright and passionate people. We lead from the front, working with clients large and small; from broadcast and content megabrands such as Comcast, Vodafone, BeIn Sports and Disney, to dynamic streamers, niche networks and all forms of video providers.

Synamedia India is announced as 2024 Healthy Workplace by Arogya World

This award is a recognition of our commitment to employee health and well-being. We are excited to become a part of Arogya World’s healthy community of over 250 Companies spanning over 8 million employees.

We stand with Ukraine

We’re shocked by the tragedy in Ukraine and by the millions of displaced refugees. To help, we’re creating opportunities for those impacted by the war. If you, or anyone you know, is affected and looking for an opportunity, please visit Remote Ukraine, or contact our team at careers@synamedia.com.
